pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Individual dark regions exhibit rounded to sub-polygonal geometries with soft, blurred edge gradients. Spatial area of patches is largest on the neck and decreases in size toward the posterior flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous network of light-colored pelage forms an interconnected grid. Corridor thickness is variable, appearing widest on the neck and narrowing into a more dense, fine-lined mesh on the flank with distinct junction nodes connecting multiple pathways.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane along the dorsal neck presents as a continuous, dark, low-amplitude jagged silhouette against the background, though pixel-level resolution is limited by motion blur.
